v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dómine, * probásti me et cognovísti me. ‡
text.en: Lord, * thou hast proved me, and known me. ‡

text.la: Mirabília ópera tua, * Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
text.en: Wonderful are thy works * and my soul knoweth right well.

text.la: Ne derelínquas me, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
text.en: Do not thou forsake me, * O Lord, the strength of my salvation.

text.la: Dómine, * clamávi ad te, exáudi me. ‡
text.en: I have cried to thee, * O Lord, hear me. ‡

text.la: Educ de custódia * ánimam meam, Dómine, ad confiténdum nómini tuo.
text.en: Bring my soul * out of prison, O Lord, that I may praise thy name.

text.la: Benedíctus Deus, et Pater Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, Pater misericordiárum, et Deus totíus consolatiónis, qui consolátur nos in omni tribulatióne nostra.
text.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

text.la: Depósuit Dóminus * poténtes de sede, et exaltávit húmiles.
text.en: The Lord has put down * the mighty from their seat, and exalted the humble and meek.

text.la: Omnípotens et miséricors Deus, de cuius múnere venit, ut tibi a fidélibus tuis digne et laudabíliter serviátur: tríbue, quǽsumus, nobis; ut ad promissiónes tuas sine offensióne currámus.
text.en: Almighty and merciful God, of Whose only gift it cometh that thy faithful people do unto thee true and laudable service, grant, we beseech thee, that we may so faithfully serve thee in this life, that we fail not finally to attain thy heavenly promises.

office.title: Feria Sexta infra Hebd XII post Octavam Pentecostes IV. Augusti
